results.summary_before: This project implements a 4-bit binary multiplier using a combinational array structure. It multiplies two 4-bit numbers by generating partial products and summing them with full adders. The design is purely digital and produces an 8-bit product. results.summary: This project implements a 4x4 array multiplier that takes two 4-bit inputs, m and q, and produces an 8-bit product p. Partial products are generated by ANDing each bit of m with all bits of q and summed with a series of full adders. The design is purely combinational and produces an 8-bit product. It is a structural implementation suitable for learning about binary multiplication.

results.summary: This design displays the contents of a register map on a charlieplexed 8x7 LED display and can generate waveforms for PWM, UART, and WS2812 in response to a trigger. A SPI serial connection is used to set values in the register map, with CS active low, SPI mode 0, and MSB first. Auxiliary functions such as LFSR, PWM, frequency counting, and ultrasonic distance sensing are implemented as space and time permit. Testing uses SPI to read and write registers and observe the LEDs or serial response, with a charlieplexed 7x8 LED display as external hardware.
